_about: Published JWST mean-molecular-weight (mu) constraints for sub-Neptunes, for the Patchwork mu-landscape figure. mu: {value, minus, plus} | {low, high} | {lower}. kind: 'measured' (retrieved mu or a composition that fixes it), 'h2_rich' (an H2-dominated atmosphere stated by the authors), 'lower_robust' (holds with aerosols in the model), 'lower_cloudfree' (holds only if the opaque level is deeper than the authors' stated pressure; clouds can mimic it). mu_from records whether mu is quoted or converted from metallicity for a solar-scaled H/He gas (100x ~ mu 4.2-4.6, 300x ~ 7.6-10, 1000x ~ 16). ch4/co2: detected in transmission. Compiled 2026-10-22. Planet T_eq, mass and radius come from the NASA Exoplanet Archive at plot time.

TOI-421 b.mu_from: low-mu H2O features consistent with solar metallicity, no aerosols

K2-18 b.ref: Madhusudhan et al. 2023; Schmidt et al. 2025, AJ 170, 298; Fernandez-Rodriguez et al. 2026 (arXiv:2510.18098)
K2-18 b.mu_from: H2-He dominated with ~1% CH4 and <=1% CO2

TOI-270 d.ref: Benneke et al. 2024 (arXiv:2403.03325); reproduced by arXiv:2504.13039; contested by Holmberg & Madhusudhan 2024 (lower mu)

LTT 3780 c.ref: Rigby et al. 2025, ApJL 995, L70 (arXiv:2512.15844), as TOI-732 c
LTT 3780 c.mu_from: CH4 ~1% VMR in an H2-rich atmosphere

TOI-1231 b.mu_from: 'requires a thick H2-rich atmosphere'; strong CH4

V1298 Tau b.ref: Barat et al. 2025, Nat. Astron. (young, ~20 Myr)

GJ 1214 b.ref: Ohno et al. 2025, ApJL 979, L7 (arXiv:2410.10186); Schlawin et al. 2024

GJ 9827 d.mu_from: converted from H2O VMR > 31% (NIRISS+HST break the cloud degeneracy)

GJ 3090 b.mu_from: converted from Z > 100x solar, clouds at ~ubar allowed

HD 15337 c.mu_from: converted from Z > 310x solar for opaque pressure > a few mbar

TOI-836.01.mu_from: converted from Z > 175x solar if no aerosols above ~1 mbar

TOI-776 c.mu_from: converted from Z > 180x solar for clouds deeper than 1 mbar

TOI-125 b.mu_from: converted from Z >= 150x solar if clear (clouds above ~3 mbar also fit)

TOI-125 c.mu_from: converted from Z > 100x solar if clear (clouds ~10 mbar also fit)
